read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong senior seed as the holdout's role is elevated: as a peer 0.7667, as the reviewing auditor 0.1083, as the accountable attending of record 0.3417. Lower adoption under the auditor / sign-off roles would mean the hierarchy that carries a wrong seed downward can be re-pointed as an oversight seat by role assignment alone, a cheap deployment remediation; a flat curve means role labels do not help and only content-level scrutiny does. Paired McNemars test each elevated role against the peer baseline.
